Eliminated DeadlineMiddleware name lying about behavior: renamed to LatencyBudgetReporter; honest name + side-effects-run-before-504 fixture.
Eliminated speculative complexity: 8-field tech-debt ledger + trigger DSL + monotonic state machine + cross-row predicate collapsed to flat 5-field overlay.
Eliminated double-bookkeeping: layer derived from crate name (ADR-0056 BNF), not declared in metadata too.
Eliminated dri.json + role-roster.json duplicating Cargo metadata owner_team.
Cargo build graph shrinks for 5 crates that no longer transitively pull bytes.
Dependency rationales overlay is data + cargo metadata generator, not hand-authored ledger duplicating Cargo state.
Server config (max_body_bytes + timeouts) declared with safe defaults — scales horizontally without per-cell tuning.

alternatives_named: Option A — IP-002 as written (cosmetic rename only): rejected; leaves root-cause leak and quality issues.
Option B — Slimmed slice (type rename + body Vec<u8> + crate renames; defer quality + security): rejected; leaves S3-S10 security gaps.
Option C (selected) — Full quality bar: 10 phases including Q1-Q5 fixes + S1-S10 fixes + multispectrum enforcement.

For kernel body type: Option α (generic over body type with default) vs Option β (concrete Vec<u8>) vs Option γ (enum body): Option β selected for current scale; F-MULTI-Q-BODY-GENERIC if streaming routes need it.
For Handler trait: blanket impl on closures vs explicit handler_to_sync helper — chose explicit (coherence rules).

findings: Vec<u8> body across all phases preserves Bytes adoption outbound but allocates inbound. Per-request cost: 1 allocation + 1 copy bounded by ServerConfig.max_body_bytes (default 1 MiB).

Sanitize-at-render (SSE Phase 9) iterates payload bytes on every event emission. For LLM-streaming workloads emitting 1000+ events/sec this is non-trivial per-event overhead. Could be construction-time once if profiled hot.
Telemetry Mutex<BTreeMap> contends on every metric write. F-MULTI-Q2 deferred.

findings: TenantSlug centralization (Phase 7) tightens defense-in-depth for tenant identity validation — compliance-aligned.

Lane is report-only on day 1. SOC2/FedRAMP audits would call this a documented partial control. Soak-to-error transition is F-SOAK-FLIP-CRON.
No secret-scan over evidence file contents. F-EVIDENCE-SECRET-SCAN.
